entries.24e525d6951e3e72: In the paper products field, it has a wide range of products tailored to the papermaking conditions of each customer, along with related expertise. entries.3afb913529ff39dd: The company is a manufacturer headquartered in Inagi, Tokyo. Together with 17 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, it operates the Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business, the Electronic Materials and Photomask Business, the Environmental and Water Treatment Business and the Real Estate Leasing Business. As of November 30, 2025, the number of employees was 1,273. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.

entries.69578302003e8eed: Under the next medium-term management plan (fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028), based on the group's long-term vision of 'a corporate group that continues to create products and services that society needs for the next 100 years as a company exceeding 100 years,' it says it will work on the following management priorities based on its materiality: giving top priority to restoring earnings capacity, and developing human capital and strengthening group governance. In the Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business, in Europe it liquidated its sales subsidiary in France and set up a new sales subsidiary in Germany, and it is also moving production from its Shizuoka Plant to its subsidiary in Thailand.
entries.6a8499d22db41c38: This business manufactures and sells etched products made from metal materials and composite film materials, and photomasks used in the manufacture of semiconductors, displays, printed circuit boards, MEMS and other products. entries.a2e666c62358a68b: Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥27,842 million, broken down as follows: Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business ¥20,030 million, Electronic Materials and Photomask Business ¥4,556 million, Environmental and Water Treatment Related Business ¥2,223 million, and Real Estate Leasing Business ¥1,031 million. The Electronic Materials and Photomask Business increased from the previous year due to strong performance of photomask products, while the Environmental and Water Treatment Related Business decreased significantly from the previous year, as it prioritized responding to unprofitable projects and carefully considered orders for large-scale projects.
